content.short: Hourglass provides institutional yield for stablecoins and ran Stable's pre-deposit vaults.
content.description: Hourglass offers institutional-grade yield for stablecoins through on-chain infrastructure connected to traditional capital markets. It ran the pre-deposit vaults for Stable's early access campaign, where Phase 2 drew $1.8 billion from more than 25,000 wallets. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Hourglass.
